At call: return status permitted because uncertain_until=frozen+1 second. Window tuple remains exactly (frozen-1h+1s,frozen+1s,3601), with no admitted run, scope or receipt. cases.evidence: Always attempt byte-exact restoration before writing private evidence. neg-window-clock-seam.json is attempted on success and failure with available before/while/restored metadata, original and replacement definitions, frozen instant, live-lease context, SQL snapshots, result (nullable), primary/restoration failure types and status. Failure-path evidence is emitted after restoration from whatever snapshots were captured; original test exceptions are preserved if evidence writing also fails.

known_execution_blockers_and_uncertainti: No tests, imports, fixture setup, SQL, services, or network actions were executed while authoring this ledger.

The 25s body + 5s cleanup allocation for SQL cases is unproven; the API/workspace fixture, manifest capture, and PostgreSQL/function cleanup may exceed it. Preserve these budgets only if exact runner/fixture evidence demonstrates fit; otherwise obtain per-case reviewed limits within the approved default or exception policy.

The 215s runtime body + 25s cleanup allocation includes a 30-second original lease expiry, owned PostgreSQL/Temporal services, dispatcher startup, API/workspace setup, direct history checks, and every fixture finalizer. The current helper's full cleanup bound and fixture teardown integration have not been runtime-qualified.

SQL-only retention, shape and clock-seam tests do not query Temporal history. They make no history-absence claim; the separate actual unmodified after-deadline case supplies the direct empty-workflow-list oracle.
Temporal server retention and installed toolchain behavior must be confirmed by the pinned actual runtime case; source files and the normal flow helper do not prove execution.

The dedicated synthetic database is currently the isolated per-test migration database behind workspace_environment. Review must confirm it meets the approved seam isolation requirement before any function replacement is executed.
